meaning: Watching or hearing a show online as it plays, without saving it all first.
clues: It lets you watch a show or hear music through the internet.
The sound or picture plays as small pieces arrive. You do not wait for the whole file.
A faster connection can mean fewer pauses.
You can stop, pause, or start again from the service.
It has nine letters and starts with S.

decoys.meaning: Saving a whole file from the internet to your device before you use it.
TV service sent to a home through a cable.
Radio sent from satellites in space to receivers in cars and homes.

exchange.text: Try watching a short video. It starts playing before the whole video has arrived.
